questions.explain: 'Erneuerbare Energien' means 'renewable energy' (e.g. wind and solar).

questions.q: What does 'Ich wohne am Stadtrand' mean?
options: I live in the city centre
I live on the outskirts of town
questions.explain: 'Der Stadtrand' means 'the edge/outskirts of the town', so 'Ich wohne am Stadtrand' = 'I live on the outskirts'.
'Die Gegend' means 'the area/region/neighbourhood', e.g. 'eine ruhige Gegend' = 'a quiet area'.
'Der Müll' means 'rubbish/waste'. 'Müll trennen' = 'to separate the rubbish (for recycling)'.

questions.q: How do you say 'There is a swimming pool in my town'?
options: In meiner Stadt gibt es einen Bahnhof
In meiner Stadt fehlt ein Schwimmbad
In meiner Stadt gibt es ein Schwimmbad
In meiner Stadt gibt es ein Rathaus
questions.explain: 'Es gibt' = 'there is' and 'das Schwimmbad' = 'the swimming pool'.
'Die Umwelt' means 'the environment' (nature/planet), as in 'die Umwelt schützen' = 'to protect the environment'.

questions.q: What does 'Man muss die Umwelt schützen' mean?
options: We want to protect the environment
questions.explain: 'Man muss' + infinitive means 'one/we must', so this is 'We must protect the environment'.

questions.q: What does 'Zurzeit wohne ich in der Stadt' mean?
options: I rarely live in the city
At the moment I live in the city
I used to live in the city
I will live in the city
questions.explain: 'Zurzeit' means 'at the moment / currently', so this is 'At the moment I live in the city'.

questions.q: How do you say 'I always turn off the light'?
options: Ich mache das Licht nie aus
Ich mache das Licht immer aus
Ich mache das Licht immer an
Ich mache die Tür immer zu
questions.explain: 'Ausmachen' = 'to turn off' and 'immer' = 'always'; 'anmachen' (turn on) is the trap.
'Öffentliche Verkehrsmittel' means 'public transport'. A traffic jam is 'der Stau'.
'In der Nähe' means 'nearby/close by', e.g. 'in der Nähe der Schule' = 'near the school'.
'Die Luftverschmutzung' means 'air pollution' (Luft = air + Verschmutzung = pollution).
